facts.text: M'Uniqo Rooftop Bar is on the 13th floor, with views across Munich and toward the Bavarian Alps.

facts.text: Schwabinger Tor Brau is a neighborhood Wirtshaus and in-house brewery serving house-brewed beers.
facts.excerpt: A neighborhood Wirtshaus and in-house brewery rooted in Bavarian tradition and the contemporary energy of Schwabing. House-brewed beers and straightforward, quality-driven dishes set the tone

facts.text: The Lonely Broccoli is a meat house focused on charcoal-grilled and slow-roasted cuts and dry aging.
facts.excerpt: Charcoal-grilled and slow-roasted cuts define the menu, with a focus on dry aging and bold, precise flavors.

facts.text: Tower rooms look toward Munich's skyline and the Alps beyond.
